$comment: Browser/client project. api/, server/ and scripts/ are type-checked separately by
tsconfig.server.json under NodeNext, which is the stricter resolver that catches
extensionless ESM imports before they turn into runtime 500s.
vite/client is deliberately NOT in compilerOptions.types. A 'types' array replaces
TypeScript's automatic @types inclusion, so it both hides the other @types packages
and makes this project fail with TS2688 if vite cannot be resolved. src/vite-env.d.ts
already carries the canonical '/// <reference types="vite/client" />', which supplies
the same ImportMetaEnv types, so the entry in 'types' was redundant as well as unsafe.
include is explicit so generated bundles in dist/ and dist-server/ are never pulled
into the program; checking minified output is order-dependent and only fails on CI.
